scope_note: This is the generation-9 corrective pass responding to the independent Codex reviewer's rejection of PR #5620 exact head 6e0ed787803815cd36fff1a529a46fe486e6933d (frozen manifest blob 9fbdb67831ff904e50bfd5dd9ac05ff115760d90; full findings and reviewer-authored reproduction scripts preserved at /tmp/registry-review-6e0ed787-findings.md, /tmp/registry-review-6e0ed787-scoped.log, /tmp/registry-review-codex-6e0ed787/{artifact_cross_tenant,generic_revision_race}.{py,log}, /tmp/registry_adapter_review_probe.py, /tmp/registry-generic-race-review-repro.py, /tmp/registry-storage-review-repro.py, /tmp/registry-review-6e0ed787-root-probes.py). Each of the 9 findings is fixed with real code changes: (1) cross-tenant StrategyArtifact POST replay leak — service.py's _register_strategy_artifact now authorizes (_authorize_read, tenant/builtin scoped) an existing-row replay before comparing/returning it, instead of returning the collision unconditionally; builtins stay publicly replayable (any caller can idempotently re-register the checked-in builtin with identical content, as strategy_artifact.py's ensure_builtin_strategy_artifacts already does on every process start) since _authorize_read already treats owner_tenant==BUILTIN_TENANT as public. (2) generic-route full-StrategySpec creation bypassing the serialized revision invariant — register_entry's non-idempotent-key path now calls RegistryService.register_strategy_spec_revision (the same per-strategy_id-advisory-locked path the dedicated POST /api/registry/strategy-specs facade already used) whenever the generic payload embeds metadata.strategy_spec, instead of the plain unconditional register(); a same-key collision under this path is a genuine conflict (409), since this route always generates a fresh random registry_id. (3)/(4) BFF strategy_adapter.py update_params readback/replay verification gaps — the non-replay success path's follow-up owner-GET comparison now also asserts registry_id/strategy_id/owner_tenant identity (via _belongs_to_requested_strategy/_diverges_from_original) and that the readback's metadata actually equals the requested new_metadata (previously only checksum/updated_at/metadata-vs-PATCH-response were compared, so an owner that silently no-op'd the write, or a readback for a wholly different aggregate with a coincidentally matching checksum/updated_at/metadata, passed every check); the idempotent-replay path now additionally requires the replay body's metadata to equal the requested new_metadata, a non-null updated_at, and a present last_actor.actor_id, since registry_id/checksum/version/owner_tenant identity matching alone is not sufficient for a metadata-only commit (those fields are exactly what stays fixed while metadata is what changed). (5) create-if-absent replay comparing against mutated-since content — new PostgresRegistryStore.get_creation_receipt/RegistryStore.get_creation_receipt (backed by a same-transaction creation receipt written alongside every first successful create_if_absent/register_strategy_spec_revision insert) let service.py's _ensure_strategy_spec_registration_matches and _register_strategy_artifact compare a same-registry_id replay's claimed content against the entry's *original* creation snapshot instead of its current, possibly-since-mutated (advance/metadata-edited) fields; the row *returned* to the HTTP caller stays the live current view regardless, since a replayed create is not a request to revert real progress (e.g. an already-granted approval) back to its original draft state — proven by both a same-content-replay-after-metadata-edit-still-succeeds test and a still-rejects-genuinely-different-content test. (6) advance_artifact_state CAS bound to a server re-read, not the caller's claimed base, plus a metadata/advance receipt-namespace collision — AdvanceRequest gained optional expected_artifact_state/expected_version/expected_updated_at fields; split_api.py's advance_artifact_state merges any supplied ones onto the freshly-read base_snapshot before the CAS, so a stale caller-claimed base now fails the store's compare_and_set the same way a stale expected_metadata already does; PostgresRegistryStore.receipt_key/RegistryStore's mirrored usage gained a command_type parameter ("metadata"/"advance"/"create") folded into the framed receipt-key identity, so the same client-chosen command_key value used for both a metadata-CAS call and an advance on the same registry_id/tenant/actor can never land on the same receipt row regardless of digest coincidence. (7) storage.py's build_registry_store no longer defaults an entirely unset REGISTRY_STORE_BACKEND to the in-memory store even in dev posture (no PANTHEON_ENV) — it now always requires an explicit memory or postgres selection (RuntimeError otherwise), closing the gap where the actual mounted app silently served real writes against memory with zero configuration at all; services/registry/conftest.py already sets REGISTRY_STORE_BACKEND=memory explicitly for this whole package's unit-test run, so dev/test callers are unaffected. (8) main.py's /readyz registry_owner probe now also queries the configured receipts table (SELECT 1 FROM <receipts_table> LIMIT 0), not just entries — a missing/dropped command-receipts table (required by every idempotency-keyed create/metadata/advance commit) previously reported ready=true while the next such commit would raise a 500. (9) acceptance evidence completeness — new regression tests were added for every finding above (see files_modified), including a genuine two-thread real-Postgres concurrency proof for finding 2 (a request for a stale next-version is paused before it enters the per-strategy_id advisory lock, a different next-version is allowed to fully commit and release the lock, then the paused request resumes, re-reads the true new latest under the lock, and is correctly rejected instead of blindly committing under stale validation) and a real-Postgres proof for finding 8 (drop only the receipts table, leaving entries intact, and assert /readyz reports not-ready).

summary: service.py: _register_strategy_artifact now requires ctx and calls _authorize_read (not _authorize_write, which would have wrongly denied a builtin's own idempotent replay) on a same-registry_id replay before comparing/returning it (finding 1); its content comparison now prefers RegistryService.get_creation_receipt's original snapshot over the live view's current fields (finding 5); register_entry's non-idempotent-key path now routes a generic full-StrategySpec submission through register_strategy_spec_revision under the per-strategy_id lock instead of plain register() (finding 2); AdvanceRequest gained expected_artifact_state/expected_version/expected_updated_at, threaded through all four advance routes (finding 6); _ensure_strategy_spec_registration_matches gained an optional receipt_entry parameter used the same way for the dedicated StrategySpec facade (finding 5).

split_api.py: advance_artifact_state merges any caller-supplied expected_artifact_state/expected_version/expected_updated_at onto the freshly-read base_snapshot before the CAS and forwards them to the store for receipt-digest divergence detection (finding 6); new RegistryService.get_creation_receipt exposing the store-level original-creation snapshot (finding 5).

pg_store.py: PostgresRegistryStore.receipt_key gained a command_type parameter folded into the framed identity (finding 6); new _store_creation_receipt/_read_creation_receipt/get_creation_receipt recording and exposing the entry exactly as first created, in the same transaction as create_if_absent/register_strategy_spec_revision's insert (finding 5); commit_artifact_state_cas gained expected_artifact_state/expected_version/expected_updated_at, folded into its request digest for divergent-replay detection (finding 6).

storage.py: in-memory RegistryStore mirrors get_creation_receipt (finding 5) and the command_type-tagged receipt_key usage plus expected_*-aware commit_artifact_state_cas (finding 6); build_registry_store no longer defaults an unset REGISTRY_STORE_BACKEND to memory in any posture — it now always requires an explicit selection (finding 7).
main.py: _registry_owner_dependency's Postgres probe now also queries the configured receipts table, not just entries (finding 8).

command_adapters/strategy_adapter.py: the non-replay success readback comparison now also checks registry_id/strategy_id/owner_tenant identity and that the readback's metadata equals the requested new_metadata (finding 3); the idempotent-replay path now additionally requires the replay body's metadata to equal the requested new_metadata, a non-null updated_at, and a present last_actor.actor_id (finding 4).
test_strategy_artifact.py: test_same_child_id_concurrent_mutations_never_overwrite updated to pass the now-required ctx parameter to _register_strategy_artifact.

test_owner_durability.py: added test_generic_route_embedded_spec_serializes_concurrent_revision_race, a real-Postgres two-thread proof pausing a stale-version request before it enters the per-strategy_id advisory lock, letting a different version fully commit, then resuming and asserting the stale request is correctly rejected (400) against the true new latest (finding 2); added test_readyz_fails_closed_when_receipts_table_is_missing, dropping only the receipts table and asserting /readyz reports not-ready (finding 8).

test_storage_backend_posture.py: replaced test_unset_backend_in_dev_posture_defaults_to_memory (which asserted the now-removed implicit dev-posture memory default) with test_unset_backend_always_fails_closed_even_in_dev_posture and test_explicit_memory_backend_in_dev_posture_is_allowed (finding 7).

test_registry_owner_transaction.py: fixed test_metadata_cas_commit_and_receipt_are_one_atomic_transaction's direct receipt_key lookup to pass command_type='metadata', matching the finding-6 receipt-key change.

review.decision: This branch head (exact head 6e0ed787803815cd36fff1a529a46fe486e6933d) was rejected with 9 concrete, live-PostgreSQL-reproduced defects across cross-tenant StrategyArtifact replay authorization, a generic-route StrategySpec revision-creation TOCTOU race, BFF adapter readback/replay verification gaps, create-if-absent replay content drift after mutation, an advance_artifact_state CAS bound to a server re-read instead of the caller's claimed base plus a metadata/advance receipt-namespace collision, an implicit memory-backend default, and an incomplete readiness probe. This revision implements real fixes for all 9, verified against a live isolated PostgreSQL instance available in this session (not skipped), with new regression tests proving each fix and no regression in the pre-existing suite. Pending independent re-review; no reuse of any prior approval.
